nodes.name: Daily 08:00 Manila
nodes.notes: Workflow timezone is Asia/Manila, so this fires at 08:00 local (00:00 UTC). Daily rather than hourly: a stuck row stays stuck, and re-reporting it every hour would train everyone to ignore the alert.

nodes.name: Sweep outbox
nodes.notes: Read-only sweep action on the same endpoint CH-S01 uses, so this workflow needs no Supabase key of its own (D-051). Returns ids and statuses only, never payloads.

nodes.name: Anomalies found?
nodes.notes: True branch = something is wrong. The healthy path deliberately sends nothing; a daily 'all clear' would be noise.

parameters.text:
={{ 'Cascade outbox reconciliation - ANOMALIES FOUND
' + 'window: ' + $json.window_minutes + ' min, checked ' + $json.checked_at + '
' + 'stuck dispatched: ' + $json.counts.stuck_dispatched + '
' + 'stale pending: ' + $json.counts.stale_pending + '
' + 'failed: ' + $json.counts.failed + '
' + 'completed with no delivery record: ' + $json.counts.completed_without_delivery + ($json.truncated ? '
(results truncated - more may exist)' : '') + '
first ids: ' + [].concat($json.anomalies.stuck_dispatched, $json.anomalies.stale_pending, $json.anomalies.failed, $json.anomalies.completed_without_delivery).slice(0, 5).map(r => r.id).join(', ') }}
